title: Glitching Items
description: Rolls the SF2e glitching flat check (DC 5 + N) automatically whenever a glitching item is used, and adds Glitching 1-3 item traits.

glitching-1.label: Glitching 1
glitching-1.description: This item has the glitching 1 condition. Each time it's used, attempt a DC 6 flat check. Critical success: glitching value drops by 1. Success: works normally. Failure: item penalty of 1 to checks and DCs for this use. Critical failure: the item doesn't function and the actions are lost.
